replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really—my low neuroticism and high conscientiousness mean I approach math calmly. I focus on applying concepts rather than memorizing formulas, which keeps me steady even when tackling complex problems.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for quick calculations and explanations. It helped me understand concepts faster without overwhelming me, which aligns with my preference for practical, step-by-step guidance.
